methods.note: The text claims about the IR setup, DCT, Laplacian, K-means and LSTM are supported on pp.2-5. The experiment block labels the work custom_2d_steady with an empty floorplan and empty power. That contradicts the extraction's own steady_2d_relevant=false and the essential physical_mismatches, because the paper's method is measured IR imaging plus a transient LSTM, not a 2D steady solve.

code.note: The packet assets list is empty and artifact_search_status is checked_no_links. No code, repository, trained LSTM weights or analysis scripts are supplied. Reference [22] is only the Intel PCM tool URL, which is not evidence of reproducible code.

parameters.note: The reported scalars are supported by pdftotext: Table I RMSE values (HS#1 2.36, HS#10 2.57, HS#11 2.04), the 58.73-101.35 C range, 50 um/pixel, 60 Hz, 18 sources, 187200 samples, 52 min, 80 metrics, and the LSTM layout of 100/80/60 neurons plus an 18-neuron dense layer with 20% dropout, 100 epochs, 60 timesteps and a 60/15/25 split. No block x/y/width/height, die size, per-block watts, Peltier setpoint, material properties, or LSTM optimizer and loss are published, so the parameters needed for any 2D scenario are absent.

config.note: No pinned config or geometry asset exists. The extraction has no floorplan, no power_rows and no boundary conditions. The only physical setup details are narrative (rear Peltier cooling with a liquid-cooled hot side, bare front exposed to the IR camera). No scenario-matched config can be built, and generated coordinates would be illustrative only.

data.note: There are no per-block, same-scenario power values, no transient power traces and no digitized Fig. 8 centroid coordinates. The raw IR maps, the 187200-sample dataset and the trained weights are unpublished. Fig. 8 and Fig. 10 are not supplied as images, so the decisive figures were not visually verified. Table I and the text values come from text extraction only.

findings.reason: The kind custom_2d_steady with empty floorplan and power_w contradicts the extraction's steady_2d_relevant=false and the essential mismatches (transient LSTM, IR measurement, Peltier cooling, no power). It must not be treated as a 2D reproduction scenario.
None of the 18 heat-source blocks has a name, geometry or same-scenario power in watts. The paper says the method does not use the floorplan. Any Studio run would rest entirely on invented inputs.
